title: Order structure and signalling in higher order quantum maps
summary: We study the signalling structure of higher order quantum maps from an order-theoretic perspective, building on the combinatorial characterization of higher order types by Bisio and Perinotti. We have shown in a previous work arxiv:2411.09256 that types are represented by boolean functions called type functions, and that each such function is characterized by a related structure poset. We characterize the distributive lattice generated by all type functions with fixed indices of input and output systems - whose elements we call regular subtypes - by a monotonicity condition.
